headline: Malaysian Ringgit Weakens to 4.12 Per US Dollar
summary: The Malaysian ringgit closed lower at 4.1205/4.1250 per US dollar on Monday, easing from 4.1105 at Friday's close as market participants evaluated Federal Reserve monetary policy prospects.
why: The Malaysian ringgit exchange rate responds to shifts in US interest rate expectations and global trade conditions.

impacts.name: Malaysian Ringgit
impacts.why: The Malaysian ringgit weakened to 4.1205 against the US dollar.
